subject: Ethics Rules and Tree Ordinance Development
overview: The committee reviewed the Harvester Energy Festival, discussed administrative training requirements, and received reports on the draft tree ordinance and state ethics rules. Members also planned for upcoming events, including a heat pump webinar and the Jingle Bell Festival.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and discussed the requirement for all volunteer board members to complete biennial state conflict of interest training.

items.title: Public Outreach and Communications
items.summary: The committee discussed providing environmental and recycling tips to the Mayor’s office for dissemination via social media and local cable television.

items.title: Ethics Commission Report on Conflicts of Interest
items.summary: Gaston Fiore reported on a consultation with the State Ethics Commission, clarifying that members are exempt from financial conflict rules on general policies like the tree ordinance if their interest is shared by more than 10% of the population.

items.title: Committee Membership and Diversity
items.summary: The committee discussed recruiting new members for 2023 and emphasized the need for affirmative outreach to improve racial and ethnic diversity in the applicant pool.

items.title: Harvester Energy Festival Review
items.summary: Members reviewed the success of the October festival, noting strong turnout for recycling and shredding and praising the performance of student volunteers.

items.title: Heat Pump Webinar Announcement
items.summary: Robert Paine announced a November 16 webinar focused on heat pump technology and financing options for residents.

items.title: Draft Tree Ordinance Status
items.summary: The committee discussed recent City Council deliberations on the tree ordinance, including proposals to separate it into three distinct sections for construction, residential trees, and commission formation.

items.title: Leaf Blower Ordinance Discussion
items.summary: Members reviewed a proposed ordinance to phase out gas-powered leaf blowers, noting the difficulty of reconciling environmental goals with city financial constraints and landscaping industry concerns.

items.title: Solid Waste and Climate Policy Updates
items.summary: Alicia Hunt announced a November 29 public meeting regarding the upcoming solid waste contract and discussed the need for a grant to fund a formal net-zero plan to meet state climate goals.
